_comment: Copy-paste configs for creating each sample agent in the platform UI (Agents -> New, pick the connector, paste the config). Endpoints assume the platform can reach this service at localhost:8080. If the PLATFORM runs in Docker, replace localhost with host.docker.internal. To register every agent in one shot instead, apply ../manifests/sample-agents.yaml from the Platform as Code screen.

agents.name: voice-iva
agents.note: IVR/IVA brain - the NLU turn an voice bot calls after speech-to-text.

agents.name: dialogflow-cx
agents.note: Authentic Dialogflow CX detectIntent response shape, served locally. The native dialogflow_cx connector is locked to Google's host, so register the mock via the generic HTTP connector with the extraction path below.

agents.name: genesys-cx
agents.note: Authentic Genesys inbound-message shape, served locally. The native genesys_cloud connector is locked to the Genesys host, so register via the generic HTTP connector.
